card.title: Nintendo Switch Not turning on at all Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Not turning on at all Repair

claims.statement: Switch with no power: suspects are M92T36, PI3USB, BQ24193, MAX17050, MAX77620 and nearby parts; check continuity of the coil near BQ24193 and the fuse above the port.

procedure: Check coil near BQ24193 and port fuse continuity.
Check for shorts around the listed ICs; replace faulty part.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
